data.name: Car For Sale Together
data.detailed_description:
Start Your Automotive Journey

Car For Sale Together is an online car trading simulation that brings together exploration, story-driven elements, and free-form gameplay as you and your friends build a car dealership from scratch. The story begins with an unexpected opportunity from your uncle: running a small car dealership in a town full of hidden opportunities. At the start, you only have a limited budget, a few chances, and big ambitions. But this journey is about much more than simply buying and selling cars. As you explore different areas of the town, you will encounter new opportunities, discover hidden locations across the map, and find yourself involved in unexpected events. Around every corner, there may be a new story, a new deal, or an unexpected adventure waiting for you.

Explore the Town

Exploration is an important part of the experience. The map includes special locations you will need to reach, areas waiting to be discovered, and unique places that open the door to new activities and opportunities. During this journey, you will not only focus on trading but also on exploring the world around you, uncovering new possibilities and finding different ways to grow your business. The game world is designed to give players the freedom to move around, visit the places that spark their curiosity, and create their own stories.

Repair, Customize and Upgrade

The vehicles you purchase can be worked on in detail. You can repair mechanical issues, customize performance and appearance through the tuning system, and increase a car’s value with washing and painting. With the right touches, every vehicle can become more valuable. Throughout this process, you will develop your trading strategies while shaping the cars in your dealership according to your own style.

Night Drives and Free Roaming

By managing a shared company, you and your friends can grow the dealership together, make decisions as a team, and expand your business step by step. While spending your days trading and managing vehicles, you can head out onto the town’s roads at night, enjoy long drives with your friends, join races, or simply cruise freely through the streets. Whether you prefer relaxing night drives or adrenaline-filled moments, the town offers both.

Immersive Atmosphere

All of this takes place in an immersive and atmospheric world. Detailed environment design, locations that reflect the character of the town, and a visually rich atmosphere help players feel truly present in the game world. Every street, building, and discovery point has been carefully designed to strengthen the atmosphere and bring the town to life.

Start Your Car Trading Story

In the end, Car For Sale Together is more than just a car trading game. It is an adventure where you and your friends start from nothing, build a business together, explore a town full of opportunities, and create your own story along the way. Turning a small beginning into a thriving car dealership and sharing that journey with your friends is entirely in your hands. 🚗

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
